_comment: Template for controller-authored Rhino payload manifests. Copy to .bridge/payloads/<task-id>/manifest.json and fill required fields. Multi-pass fields are optional — omit them for single-pass payloads. Do not commit with _comment or unfilled placeholders.
operation_name: <short snake_case name describing what the script does>
sha256: <sha256 hex digest of rhino.py as committed>
notes: <Optional: describe geometry intent, expected side effects, any special targeting requirements.>
_multi_pass_comment: Fields below are OPTIONAL. Omit for single-pass payloads. See .bridge/workflows/MULTI_PASS_RHINO.md.
modeling_run_id: <optional: stable ID shared across all passes of this model, e.g. run-abc123>
parent_task_id: <optional: task_id of the immediately preceding pass>
parent_payload_sha256: <optional: sha256 of the preceding pass's rhino.py>
parent_result_commit: <optional: result_commit SHA from the preceding pass's report>
